description: The native Blazor report engine is a part of the reporting tool for Blazor and .NET platform that renders reports from getting data from the source, building bands, calculating aggregate functions, charting, applying styles, conditions, filtering, sorting, and more. Also, the report engine has algorithms for exporting reports to various formats such as PDF, Rich Text, Excel, and others.
